guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows emailservice latency p90 and p50 spiked by 4498% and 1334% respectively (z-scores of 899.74 and 266.87), far exceeding all other metrics. Traces confirm emailservice is on the critical path for the slowest requests, causing frontendservice to timeout and report errors, while the absence of log errors or resource saturation indicates a pure delay fault.

proposed_fix.description: Implement circuit breakers and strict timeouts on checkoutservice calls to emailservice to prevent cascading timeouts, and profile emailservice to resolve its underlying latency regression.
